title: Submit requirements
subtitle: Let the influencers know what you are looking for.
describeProduct: Describe the product/service you are promoting
describeProductPlaceholder: E.g. We just launched our summer dress collection and want you to promote our sundresses that are 100% handmade
contentRequirementsPlaceholder: E.g. We would like you to style the dress with different accessories and make the content vibrant and colorful
physicalProduct: Are you shipping a physical product?
productCostPlaceholder: What is your cost on the product (USD)
useForAds: Will you be using the content for ads?
additionalRequirements: What do you need from the influencers to get started?
additionalRequirementsPlaceholder: E.g. Please send us your dress size and color preference
deliveryDate: When do you expect the content to be delivered by?
deliveryDateInfo: This helps understand your timeline. It should be used as a guideline and not a deadline.
